quote: Every minute of Frank’s guided study of the battlefields around Monte Cassino was more enthralling than the last. The Allied landings in Italy and advance on Rome present some of the most awe-inspiring military feats, on both sides of the war, from individual up to Corps level. At every turn, Frank enthusiastically brings the events to life with contemporary doctrinal context and analysis that he readily related to a mix of ranks from Corporal up to Lieutenant Colonel. I cannot imagine a better guide.
name: Capt Andy Brown
from: Joint Ground Based Air Defence Workshops
